newsitem.title: CHINA: China, Canada sign commodity inspection pact.
newsitem.headline: China, Canada sign commodity inspection pact.

text.p: China and Canada have signed a memorandum of understanding to boost cooperation on a licensing system for import and export commodities, the Business Daily said on Sunday.

The agreement between the China State Administration of Import and Export Commodity Inspection and the Canadian Standards Association (CSA) would expand an existing inspection pact to cover product testing and certification, the newspaper said.
The new agreement would set up a quality assurance programme and give the CSA a role in the safety and quality licence system for import and export commodities, it said without elaborating.

The two organisations had signed an inspection and follow-up services pact in October 1986, it said, adding that goods from more than 1,100 factories in China had been certified by the CSA for export to Canada.
